Initial release of Automation Workflows for solopreneurs

- Provides a comprehensive playbook for identifying, designing, and implementing no-code automation workflows.
- Includes step-by-step guidance: opportunity identification, tool selection (Zapier, Make, n8n), workflow design, building, testing, and maintenance.
- Offers actionable examples, templates, and low-hanging-fruit checklists for common business automations.
- Covers troubleshooting, error handling, documentation, and advanced automation ideas to scale operations efficiently.
